description: Defines a thread-safe weak pointer implementation in the 'base' namespace, including classes for weak references, weak pointer factories, and support for weak pointers in objects. Provides mechanisms for safe object referencing without affecting object lifetime, with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: WeakReference
classes.description: Represents a weak reference to an object, with thread-safe validity checks.

classes.name: WeakReferenceOwner
classes.description: Manages ownership of WeakReference objects, allowing invalidation.

classes.name: WeakPtrBase
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for weak pointers.

classes.name: SupportsWeakPtrBase
classes.description: Provides static methods for safe downcasting of weak pointers.

classes.name: WeakPtr
classes.description: Template class representing a weak pointer to an object of type T.

classes.name: WeakPtrFactory
classes.description: Creates and manages weak pointers for an object, allowing invalidation.

classes.name: SupportsWeakPtr
classes.description: Mixin class that enables an object to produce weak pointers to itself.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a WeakPtr to the object managed by WeakPtrFactory.

methods.name: InvalidateWeakPtrs
methods.description: Invalidates all weak pointers created by the factory.

methods.name: AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a WeakPtr to the object, enabling safe weak referencing.
